source.title: Leon Alberti’s disk cipher and Liber Primus
source.author: |vi

comparison: Recount the exact LP2-39 row's runes and separators; sum both posted 13-element final arrays in their fixed 4-5-4 groups; compare the two four-element short overlays with the posted source sums; reduce signed sums using ordinary nonnegative residues modulo 31; repeat the short-period calculation at all 13 cyclic starting positions as an alignment-sensitivity audit.
exclusions: No disk alphabet, rule-transition implementation, branch decoding, word-fragment search, or probability of the post-selected match. The excerpt has images and references to separate method files, but their exact alphabets and transition tables are not present here.
